candidate.method: Apply net production diff to isolated copies of current GTL sources; compile and prepend candidate classes to current runtime classpath.

method.failure_rechecks: One JUnit test per fresh JVM, three repeats, unchanged test budgets.
method.seed_matrix: 432 combinations per JVM, three alternating current/candidate pairs. Expected feasibility: stock >= quantity or host + stock >= seed. Independent physical stock and startup-seed witness for feasible plans.
method.ordinary_stress: Three JVMs per harness. Planner and certificate: 3 warmups and 12 measured samples per scenario. Side: 1 warmup and 5 measured samples per quantity. Planner/side caller deadline: 15 seconds. Independent BigInteger supply-order replay outside timing; incomplete plans replay with their declared missing stock.
method.percentiles: Median of the three JVM p50 summaries; maximum over all measured samples.
